exact_invariants.qualification: Assumes each full observed label alone deterministically decodes to its full distinct mansion name. Repetition observation preceded the design; this is an exact conditional contradiction, not a p value. Does not reject contextual codes, ambiguous abbreviation, non-name descriptions or all lunar interpretations.
